zh.title: 星宇航空第二架空山基藝術機抵台8月20日首航東京
zh.summary: 星宇航空第二客機空山金抵台，將於8月20日首航東京成田。
body: 星宇航空與日本藝術家空山基合作的第二架A350-1000藝術聯名客機「空山金」（B-58554）於法國時間8月14日完成交機，並於台北時間8月16日上午9時43分抵達桃園機場。
該客機機身融合空山基金屬美學，客艙設有4席頭等艙、40席商務艙、36席豪華經濟艙及270席經濟艙。其與7月首航的「空山銀」客機，共同組成該航空公司的藝術聯名雙機。
「空山金」預計於8月20日首航台北至東京成田航線（JX800班機），並於8月26日飛航曼谷。隨著新機抵台，該航空公司機隊規模已達到36架，其中包含4架A350-1000型客機。

en.title: STARLUX Airlines' Second Sorayama Art Livery Aircraft Arrives in Taiwan Ahead of Tokyo Debut
en.summary: STARLUX Airlines' second Sorayama art livery aircraft arrived in Taiwan, planning a Tokyo debut on August 20.
body: STARLUX Airlines' second A350-1000 art livery aircraft "AIRSORAYAMA GOLD" (B-58554) was delivered in France on August 14, 2026, and arrived at Taoyuan Airport at 9:43 AM on August 16. Designed with Japanese artist Hajime Sorayama, the aircraft features a metallic gold livery.

The aircraft is configured with four first class, 40 business, 36 premium economy, and 270 economy seats. It joins the "AIRSORAYAMA SILVER" (B-58553) aircraft, which made its maiden flight on July 12.

The new aircraft is scheduled to make its inaugural flight on the Taipei-Tokyo Narita route (JX800) on August 20, followed by flights to Bangkok on August 26. This delivery increases STARLUX's fleet to 36 aircraft, including four A350-1000s.

zh.title: 倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）水管破裂淹水 聯合與美國及達美航廈道路受阻
zh.summary: 倫敦希斯洛機場爆水管導致周邊道路淹水，聯合、美國與達美航廈道路中斷。
body: 倫敦希斯洛機場周邊一條主水管破裂引發淹水，導致中央航廈附近的道路遭水淹沒，造成現場旅客與工作人員受困滯留。
這起積水事件已切斷並關閉通往 United、American 與 Delta 航廈的道路交通，使得相關航廈的陸路連結無法通行。
淹水區域主要集中於希斯洛機場中央航廈周邊幹道，受影響的航廈包含 United、American 及 Delta 航廈。
根據 Simple Flying 消息，道路關閉致使車輛無法正常進入該區，使得現場旅客與工作人員遭滯留於當地。

en.title: London Heathrow (LHR) Flooding Cuts Road Access to United, American, and Delta Terminals
en.summary: Flooding from a burst water main at London Heathrow blocked road access to United, American, and Delta terminals.
body: A burst water main has submerged roads surrounding the central terminals at London Heathrow Airport, causing road access disruptions across the immediate area. The flooding stranded passengers and airport staff who were attempting to travel through the affected terminal roads.
The road closure directly affected access to terminals utilized by United, American, and Delta. Vehicle traffic toward these central facilities was cut off as water covered the key roadway routes.

According to Simple Flying, the submerged roads left travelers and workers unable to enter or exit the terminal area by vehicle while road access to the United, American, and Delta terminals remained shut.
